R705.note: ObjectInputFilter allowlist (OrderEvent + java.lang/util/time/io) correctly closes the deserialization vector and reuses the existing try/catch to surface rejection as RuntimeException per contract; completeness of the allowlist for OrderEvent's actual field types (e.g. any BigDecimal/custom fields) can't be verified since OrderEvent.java isn't in the bundle.

R706.note: Replaces implicit AES/ECB with AES/GCM plus random IV prepended to ciphertext before Base64 encoding; format change is disclosed and the key holder can still recover the value, satisfying the stated contract.

R707.note: ReadAtLeastAsync guarantees the header buffer is fully populated or throws before the signature check runs, correctly closing the short-read bypass; returned bytesRead is now a constant equal to header.Length, but since a full read is now guaranteed this is not an actual value change.

R708.note: Uses JNDI's parameterized filter substitution ({1} placeholder + filters array) for the uid clause, matching the pattern already used for street; clean, standard fix.

R709.note: Replaces fmt.Sprintf string building with a ? placeholder passed through sqlx's parameter binding; standard correct fix.

R710.note: Narrows the CSRF ignore pattern from /api/** to /api/webhooks/**, matching the intent already documented in the file's own comments; restores CSRF protection on account routes as required.

R711.note: loadProjectExport's body only checks `if (!userId) return null`, which is always false for any authenticated caller (requireAuth already guarantees req.user); it never filters by ownership, so any authenticated user can still fetch any project's export - the vulnerability is not actually closed despite the added parameter and comments describing the intended query.

R712.note: Replaces GroovyShell.evaluate with a deny-by-default JexlSandbox and a minimal MapContext exposing only basePrice/quantity, correctly blocking reflective/method-call escape while still supporting the documented arithmetic/ternary formula shape.

R713.note: Adds a bounds check (position < record.size()) before the write and openly states the choice to skip invalid peer offsets rather than throw; closes the out-of-bounds write without affecting valid offsets.

R714.note: Removes verify_signature:false and decodes with the app's secret and explicit HS256 algorithm, restoring signature verification; legitimate signed tokens are unaffected.

R715.note: Switches proc_open to the array argument form with a '--' end-of-options marker before $term, closing both shell metacharacter injection and option/flag injection; standard correct fix.

R716.note: Replaces orderByRaw with a validated column/direction allowlist feeding orderBy(); default sort 'created_at desc' still parses and works, and the allowlist restriction is exactly what the stated contract requires.

R717.note: Regex allowlist blocks all LDAP metacharacters, closing the injection, but also imposes a 3-64 character alphanumeric/dot/underscore/hyphen bound not required by the sink or derivable from the case, which could reject legitimate AD usernames outside that charset or length; the restriction is disclosed in the write-up.

R718.note: Replaces strcat/strcpy with strlcat/strlcpy, checking for truncation before any write occurs (matching the classic CWE-787 fix for this exact pattern); legitimate short filenames are unaffected.
